    CV

    About me

    I am a robotics and biomedical engineer specialising in social robotics for healthcare and assistive applications. My work focuses on deploying social robots in real-world scenarios, combining robotics software development, research, and project coordination across industry and academia in Spain, Japan, and the UK.

    Education

    Master in Robotics (with Distinction)
    Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh, UK — 2018–2019

    • Robotics Operating System (ROS), biologically inspired computation, robot kinematics
    • MSc thesis on human–robot object handover with TIAGo, in collaboration with psychologists from the University of Stirling
    • EEG-based cognitive load analysis (user study with 16 participants)

    Bachelor in Biomedical Engineering
    Mondragon Unibertsitatea, Mondragon, Spain — 2014–2018

    • Project-based learning: infant incubator, ECG acquisition system, hip implant design
    • Final-year project at Middlesex University (London) using the Pepper robot for cognitive stimulation
    • User study with 10 older adults

    Work experience

    Research Scientist
    IIIA–CSIC, Bellaterra, Spain — April 2025 – Present

    • Development of a small social robot for children with autism
    • EMOROBCARE project

    Social Robotics Research Engineer
    PAL Robotics, Barcelona, Spain — July 2024 – March 2025

    • Development of social interaction scenarios using TIAGo Head
    • Integration of LLMs, knowledge bases, and perception pipelines in ROS 2
    • News-reading and social mediation applications

    Research Scientist
    Honda Research Institute Japan, Wako, Japan — April 2023 – February 2024

    • Tabletop social mediator robot (Haru) for cross-cultural interaction
    • Project coordination and user-case development
    • Cross-cultural pilot studies in Japan and Australia
    • Research on socio-emotional interaction design (dialogue, expressiveness)
    • Publications and presentations at HRI and RO-MAN

    Robotics Software Engineer & Technical Expert
    PAL Robotics, Barcelona, Spain — January 2020 – January 2023

    • Technical expert for the ARI social robot
    • Project management for internal, national, and EU projects (H2020 SPRING, SHAPES)
    • Technical coordination of healthcare robotics deployments
    • Development in ROS, Python, JavaScript
    • Dialogue pipelines (RASA, Vosk), behavior trees, touchscreen interfaces
    • Co-design with older adults for cognitive games, reminders, and home interaction
    • Real-world pilot deployments in care facilities
